items.title: 4.9 Dawa ki paidawar aur khuraak (dosage) mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9, printed page 91, with a self-check.

blocks.text: Dawa ki zaroori khuraak (dose) tayyar karte waqt dawa mein active ingredient (asal asar karne wala juz) ki bilkul munasib (optimum) miqdar zaroori hai, taake mareez par mutloob asar ho. Stoichiometry dawa banane (drug synthesis) mein durustagi (accuracy) yaqeeni banati hai. Zara si ghalti se reaction adhoora reh sakta hai, ya dawa mein bina react kiye reactants ya by-products ki milawat (contamination) ho sakti hai. Stoichiometry ki madad se chemists reactions ko theek theek control kar ke dawaein banate hain, aur un ki efficiency, asar aur mehfooz istemal yaqeeni banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek tablet banate waqt ek reactant equation ki zaroorat se thora kam dala gaya. Is chapter ki roshni mein batayein ke dawa mein kya kharabi ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Woh reactant limiting ban jayega, to active ingredient irade se kam banega aur dose kam hogi. Doosra reactant excess mein bach kar dawa mein milawat karega, jo nuqsan-deh ho sakta hai. Sahi stoichiometric miqdar se hi khalis aur durust dose milti hai.

items: Sahi dose ke liye active ingredient ki munasib miqdar zaroori hai; stoichiometry dawa banane ko durust rakhti hai aur adhoore reaction ya milawat se bachati hai.
